title: BNV2K's single 'Nag-Iisang Ikaw' turns struggles into song of hope
summary: Rising pop group BNV2K sees the growing traction of its song “Nag-Iisang Ikaw” as motivation to keep pursuing music despite the struggles they have faced along the way.
